title: Lead {name} to {target}
The mule and the road
summary: Lead {name} the {mob}, laden with goods for {target}, safely there: {distance} to the {direction}. If {name} is lost, so is the quest.
offer: {name} here carries our goods for {target}, {distance} to the {direction}. The roads aren't safe to walk alone. Lead {name} there for us? Mind the wolves.
progress: Keep {name} on the lead and off the cliffs.
complete: {name} made it! And the goods too. Well walked.
